description: This Java source file defines the DefaultTbEdgeService class, which manages edge entities in the Thingsboard platform, including saving, deleting, assigning to customers, and setting root rule chains.

classes.name: DefaultTbEdgeService
classes.description: Service class for managing Edge entities, including creation, deletion, assignment, and rule chain management.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves an Edge entity, assigns rule chains if new, and logs the action.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes an Edge entity and logs the deletion.

methods.name: assignEdgeToCustomer
methods.description: Assigns an Edge to a Customer and logs the assignment.

methods.name: unassignEdgeFromCustomer
methods.description: Unassigns an Edge from a Customer and logs the unassignment.

methods.name: assignEdgeToPublicCustomer
methods.description: Assigns an Edge to the public customer and logs the action.

methods.name: setEdgeRootRuleChain
methods.description: Sets the root rule chain for an Edge and logs the update.
